explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/972: 'Let α>1 be irrational. Are there infinitely many primes p such that ⌊pα⌋ is also prime?' The Lean statement says for every irrational α > 1 the set of primes p with ⌊α·p⌋₊ prime is infinite. Nat.floor agrees with the real floor since α·p > 0. Exact match with the question as posed.
